title: Tue 10 Nov 2026: France names Iran's IRGC for the fridge attacks, N-able pulls N-central, Qubole's keys
description: 24-hour window. France attributes October supermarket refrigeration sabotage to the IRGC's Shahid Kaveh unit; N-able takes N-central offline after 33 flaws published with exploits; four new KEV entries (SSHole, GPUStack, FreeSWITCH, Aspera Faspex) due 12 Nov; Chrome zero-day; Silent Ransom Group adds Wilentz; Japan's email-relay breach wave widens.
